parameters.name: Device Factory Reset
parameters.comment: Set the device parameters to the default value.

parameters.name: Device ID
parameters.comment: For manual settings(non switch) : Real ID = Setted Value - 1000 -- so write requested ID + 1000

parameters.name: Max. Balance Count
parameters.comment: Maximum number of cells allowed to balance simultaneously. The effective value may be reduced at runtime by the temperature based balance limiter (see Max. Balance Count in ENKO Monitoring).

parameters.name: Balance Voltage
parameters.comment: Main balance start voltage: balancing is considered only for cells above this voltage level.

parameters.name: Balance Threshold Voltage
parameters.comment: Balance threshold added to the lowest cell voltage: a cell starts balancing when its voltage exceeds both the balance voltage and (minimum cell voltage + this threshold).

parameters.name: Fan High Limit
parameters.comment: Fan turn-on temperature: the fan output switches on when any monitored board temperature (resistor board 1/2 or control board) rises above this value.

parameters.name: Fan Low Limit
parameters.comment: Fan turn-off temperature: the fan output switches off when all monitored board temperatures fall below this value.

parameters.name: CANBUS BaudRate
parameters.comment: CAN bus bit rate selection.

parameters.name: SDCARD Log Period
parameters.comment: SD card logging interval in seconds.

parameters.name: SoC Full Reset Voltage
parameters.comment: Cell voltage at which the SOC is reset to 100% (full charge anchor).

parameters.name: SoC Empty Reset Voltage
parameters.comment: Cell voltage at which the SOC is reset to 0% (empty anchor).

parameters.name: SOC-Initial
parameters.comment: Initial SOC value used at startup / first initialization.

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 1 Gain
parameters.comment: Calibration gain for cell pressure sensor 1, applied as value/10000 (10000 = 1.000x).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 1 Offset
parameters.comment: Calibration offset for cell pressure sensor 1, subtracted from the reading (value/10).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 2 Gain
parameters.comment: Calibration gain for cell pressure sensor 2, applied as value/10000 (10000 = 1.000x).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 2 Offset
parameters.comment: Calibration offset for cell pressure sensor 2, subtracted from the reading (value/10).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 3 Gain
parameters.comment: Calibration gain for cell pressure sensor 3, applied as value/10000 (10000 = 1.000x).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 3 Offset
parameters.comment: Calibration offset for cell pressure sensor 3, subtracted from the reading (value/10).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 4 Gain
parameters.comment: Calibration gain for cell pressure sensor 4, applied as value/10000 (10000 = 1.000x).

parameters.name: Cell Pressure 4 Offset
parameters.comment: Calibration offset for cell pressure sensor 4, subtracted from the reading (value/10).

parameters.name: Current Transducer Offset
parameters.comment: Zero-current offset subtracted from the current sensor reading; a small deadband around zero is forced to 0 A.

parameters.name: SOC Nominal Capacity
parameters.comment: Nominal battery pack capacity used as the coulomb counting reference.

parameters.name: Calibration Gain Negative Current
parameters.comment: Current calibration gain applied to negative (discharge) current readings, as value/10000 (10000 = 1.000x).

parameters.name: BMU Cell Number
parameters.comment: Number of cells connected to and monitored by the BMU.

parameters.name: Current Direction Multiplier
parameters.comment: Current sensor direction selection: when set to discharge, the calibrated current is negated so the charge/discharge polarity of the sensor can be flipped.

parameters.name: Calibration Gain Positive Current
parameters.comment: Current calibration gain applied to positive (charge) current readings, as value/10000 (10000 = 1.000x).

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Protection
parameters.comment: Protection trip threshold: the pack over-voltage protection alarm trips when the total pack voltage rises to or above this value (always active).

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Protection Th.
parameters.comment: Hysteresis (release band) for the pack over-voltage protection: after tripping, the alarm clears only once the value recovers past the trip threshold by this amount.

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Protection Delay
parameters.comment: Confirmation delay: the pack over-voltage condition must persist for this many milliseconds before the alarm trips. The warning of the same group shares this delay.

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Protection NOT
parameters.comment: Trip counter for the pack over-voltage protection: counts how many times the alarm has tripped (informational, readable over Modbus); 0 disables the counter.

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Protection DECDLY
parameters.comment: Counter decrement period: while the pack over-voltage alarm is inactive, its trip counter (NOT) decreases by 1 every this many hours; 0 = the counter never decreases.

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Warning
parameters.comment: Warning trip threshold: the pack over-voltage warning trips when the total pack voltage rises to or above this value (always active).

parameters.name: Pack Over Voltage Warning Th.
parameters.comment: Hysteresis (release band) for the pack over-voltage warning: after tripping, the warning clears only once the value recovers past the trip threshold by this amount.

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Protection
parameters.comment: Protection trip threshold: the pack under-voltage protection alarm trips when the total pack voltage falls to or below this value (always active).

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Protection Th.
parameters.comment: Hysteresis (release band) for the pack under-voltage protection: after tripping, the alarm clears only once the value recovers past the trip threshold by this amount.

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Protection Delay
parameters.comment: Confirmation delay: the pack under-voltage condition must persist for this many milliseconds before the alarm trips. The warning of the same group shares this delay.

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Protection NOT
parameters.comment: Trip counter for the pack under-voltage protection: counts how many times the alarm has tripped (informational, readable over Modbus); 0 disables the counter.

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Protection DECDLY
parameters.comment: Counter decrement period: while the pack under-voltage alarm is inactive, its trip counter (NOT) decreases by 1 every this many hours; 0 = the counter never decreases.

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Warning
parameters.comment: Warning trip threshold: the pack under-voltage warning trips when the total pack voltage falls to or below this value (always active).

parameters.name: Pack Under Voltage Warning Th.
parameters.comment: Hysteresis (release band) for the pack under-voltage warning: after tripping, the warning clears only once the value recovers past the trip threshold by this amount.

parameters.name: Cell Over Voltage Protection
parameters.comment: Protection trip threshold: the cell over-voltage protection alarm trips when the highest cell voltage rises to or above this value (always active).

parameters.name: Cell Over Voltage Protection Th.
parameters.comment: Hysteresis (release band) for the cell over-voltage protection: after tripping, the alarm clears only once the value recovers past the trip threshold by this amount.

parameters.name: Cell Over Voltage Protection Delay
parameters.comment: Confirmation delay: the cell over-voltage condition must persist for this many milliseconds before the alarm trips. The warning of the same group shares this delay.

parameters.name: Cell Over Voltage Protection NOT
